findings.title: Prepared reception answers misplaced allegiance
findings.claim: The verse presents Hell as a reception already prepared for the rejected choice to assign God's servants the role of protective allies.
findings.mechanism: Rejection, supportive proximity, divine preparation, and guest provision meet in the focus: the misassigned alliance supplies the recipient condition while preparation and lodging make the consequence an arranged reception.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing phrase becomes more than a punishment appended to the question; it reads as the destination prepared for the particular allegiance the question exposes.
findings.containment: This deepens the plain warning about taking protectors besides God and does not replace it with a general theory of hospitality.

epistemic.reason: The trusted nomination is directly anchored in the focus and all four nominated branches have accepted focus records.

findings.containment: This is an attributed pericope-level reading that sharpens the focus's false supposition; the context also permits the narrower alternative that the preceding ayah describes the error without causing it.

findings.title: Appropriated functions
findings.claim: The focus condemns an operation of taking God-directed persons and signs into rival or nullifying functions: patron, mockery, and partner.
findings.mechanism: The focus taking construction assigns God's servants a supportive role; the repeated construction in 18:106 assigns signs and messengers the role of mockery, while the closing prohibition names partnership as the same kind of rivalizing transfer.
findings.reader_payoff: The false-patronage question becomes part of a local pattern in which what is directed toward God is seized and made to serve an opposing function.
findings.containment: The appropriation relation extends the focus through the supplied pericope and returns to the plain question about taking servants as protectors; it does not collapse patronage, mockery, and partnership into one lexical gloss.

epistemic.reason: All ten HFT roles are anchored by exact Arabic and return through focus words, but the context traces are legacy-unbound surface evidence with no supplied target morphology.

findings.title: Reception takes its value from destination
findings.claim: The repeated reception term is a neutral allotment whose value is supplied by host and destination: the focus names Hell as lodging, while the later paired use names an enduring garden residence.
findings.mechanism: Hell is first exposed, then called prepared lodging; the same lodging term returns for the gardens and is followed by endurance and no desired transfer, so the contrast comes through destination and relation rather than a one-time sarcastic use.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus lodging term participates in a paired reception pattern, with its adverse setting and its later favorable counterpart both remaining visible.
findings.containment: The paired reception reading preserves Hell as the focus's prepared lodging and keeps the garden contrast as contextual illumination; it does not make the two destinations equivalent.

epistemic.reason: Exact Arabic anchors supply repeated reception, exposure, contrasting garden, endurance, and non-transfer; the HFT remains legacy-unbound and unresolved context branches are attributed.

findings.title: A contained material analogy
findings.claim: As a contained material analogy, the focus's attempt to hold close protectors inside its arrangement is reversed by the nearby surging-and-gathering scene and by the prepared lodging that actually contains the actors.
findings.mechanism: The basin branch of taking meets the focus's proximity relation, while wave and gathering from 18:99 supply a physical field; preparation and lodging return the analogy to the focus by assigning containment to the divine arrangement rather than to the would-be arrangers.
findings.reader_payoff: The false alliance can be seen as an imagined enclosure, and the surrounding sequence makes the reversal of agency perceptible without replacing the ordinary protector reading.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory material analogy, not the lexical sense of the focus verb; it is bounded by the supplied taking, proximity, preparation, lodging, wave, and gathering contacts.

epistemic.reason: The outlier supplies an exact two-ayah trace and an explicit containment note, but its source is legacy-unbound, several context branches lack independent registry records, and the image is marked exploratory.
